testing_centers.notes: Available at Certiport Authorized Testing Centers (primarily academic)

id_requirements: One valid, government-issued photo ID. Name on ID must match registration. For online: webcam required, room must be clear of people and materials.
exam_rules: No notes, books, or study materials. No phones or smartwatches. Whiteboard or scratch paper may be provided by testing center. Online: no dual monitors, no virtual machines, no headphones, must be alone in a closed room.
renewal_options: Microsoft certifications (Associate/Expert/Specialty) are renewed annually for free via a short renewal assessment on Microsoft Learn. Renewal assessment available 6 months before expiry. Fundamentals certifications do not expire.
target_audience: Candidates responsible for participating in all phases of development, including requirements gathering, design, development, deployment, security, maintenance, performance tuning, and monitoring.
recommended_experience: At least two years of programming experience. Proficiency in programming with Azure SDKs. Proficiency using Azure CLI, Azure PowerShell, and other tools.

prerequisites.description: At least two years of programming experience.
Proficiency in programming with Azure SDKs.
Proficiency using Azure CLI, Azure PowerShell, and other tools.

retake_policy.notes: No waiting period for first retake if score >= 500 on failed attempt. If score < 500: 14-day waiting period before retake. Maximum 5 attempts per exam per year (365 days). Free retake voucher sometimes included in official instructor-led training.

editorial.meta_description: AZ-204 is retired. Compare its historical blueprint with AI-200, see what transfers, and rebuild your plan around the current Microsoft exam.
editorial.overview: AZ-204 was Microsoft's Developing Solutions for Microsoft Azure exam until its retirement on 2026-07-31. Its final published scope covered Develop Azure compute solutions, Develop for Azure storage, Implement Azure security, Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize Azure solutions, Connect to and consume Azure services and third-party services. This page preserves that dated outline for historical comparison and curriculum cleanup. It is not a schedulable exam, and its prices, delivery details, registration links, and practice calls to action must not be used for a new certification plan.
editorial.who_should_take: Nobody should start a new certification plan around AZ-204. This page serves former candidates, credential holders, training teams removing stale material, and practitioners deciding whether prior preparation is reusable for AI-200. New candidates should verify the active Microsoft page and current dated study guide before booking.
skills_summary: Preserve practical experience from Develop Azure compute solutions only where the current guide shows meaningful overlap
Preserve practical experience from Develop for Azure storage only where the current guide shows meaningful overlap
Preserve practical experience from Implement Azure security only where the current guide shows meaningful overlap
Preserve practical experience from Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize Azure solutions only where the current guide shows meaningful overlap
Preserve practical experience from Connect to and consume Azure services and third-party services only where the current guide shows meaningful overlap
editorial.preparation_strategy: Do not rename an old AZ-204 checklist or question bank as AI-200. Compare the two official guides objective by objective and classify each historical skill as transferable, changed, or absent. Use transferable experience as a diagnostic baseline, then rebuild labs and review around AI-200's current domain weights, products, role expectations, security controls, and operational tasks. Because Microsoft identifies AI-200 as the direct replacement, review the skill map below before assuming equivalence.

methodology.summary: Cert Atlas compared Microsoft's final AZ-204 study guide with the current AI-200 guide at the domain and objective level, then checked Microsoft's retirement list and transition announcement. OpenAI Codex assisted with extraction, normalization, comparison, and drafting. Claims were reviewed against the linked official sources; no exam stems, answers, choices, or explanations were used.

lifecycle.summary: Microsoft retired AZ-204 and the Azure Developer Associate certification on July 31, 2026. Microsoft identifies AI-200 and the Azure AI Cloud Developer Associate certification as its replacement.

replacement.name: Developing AI Cloud Solutions on Azure

migration_actions: Stop scheduling, selling, or presenting AZ-204 as a current exam.
Compare completed AZ-204 preparation with the current AI-200 guide; do not carry over obsolete weighting or mechanics.
Create a fresh AI-200 plan around its current domains and hands-on role expectations.
Remove or quarantine practice content that cannot be mapped to a current objective with source evidence.
Recheck Microsoft's dated AI-200 study guide before booking because role-based exams change over time.
